name: Analyze financial metrics by industry
sql:
SELECT principal_activities, COUNT(*) AS company_count,
       AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue,
       SUM(total_assets) AS total_assets,
       AVG(business_segments_num) AS avg_segments
FROM finance
WHERE principal_activities IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY principal_activities
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
reason: Aggregations over financial data from long documents; principal_activities is multi-valued
